title: solenostemon monostachyus
intro: Solenostemon monostachyus, commonly known as Coleus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, inflammation, and digestive issues due to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Solenostemon monostachyus include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic agent, which can help in wound healing and reducing oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
